ctaHeading: Altona North's plasterers are ready — let's finish your walls.
aboutText: With over 15 years of experience delivering high-quality plastering across Melbourne's western suburbs, our Altona North-based team specialises in internal plastering, external rendering, and Gyprock installation. We pride ourselves on a neat, professional finish every time — whether it's a new build, renovation, or repair job. Altona North homeowners and builders trust us for reliable service and honest pricing across every project.
servicesText: From new builds to renovations, our Altona North plastering team delivers clean, durable finishes. We handle internal plastering, external rendering, Gyprock installation, and repair work across residential and commercial properties.

services.title: Internal Plastering
services.desc: Smooth, seamless plaster finishes for new builds and renovations throughout Altona North homes.

services.title: External Rendering
services.desc: Durable render application for exterior walls, improving insulation and kerb appeal.

services.title: Gyprock Installation
services.desc: Professional plasterboard setup for walls and ceilings in homes and commercial spaces.

services.title: Ceiling & Cornice Work
services.desc: Expert cornice installation and ceiling finishing to add character and polish.

services.title: Plaster Repairs
services.desc: Crack filling, patching and water damage repair to restore walls to perfect condition.

services.title: Decorative Plastering
services.desc: Feature walls, archways and custom plaster details for standout interior design.

reviews.text: The team at Altona North Plastering did an outstanding job on our new extension's internal plastering. Every wall is perfectly smooth and the cornices look fantastic. Couldn't be happier with the result.
reviews.name: Dave Mitchell

reviews.text: We've used Altona North Plastering for three commercial fitouts now. Their external rendering work is always top-quality, delivered on time and within budget. Highly recommend for any builder in Melbourne's west.

reviews.text: Great plaster repair work on our rental property in Newport. They patched the water damage and matched the existing finish perfectly. Fair pricing and really easy to deal with as a property manager.
